title: Train/Test/Inference Alignment Report
description: Output of train-test-alignment-auditor (the '对齐人'). A hard gate: verdict BLOCK means train/test/inference are not aligned and the comparison would be invalid. Domain-specific extra invariants come from the active profile. R3 A2 (2026-08-07): zero_training + skipped_invariants record when the dual-lock no-training escape hatch (check_alignment(..., zero_training=True)) legitimately skipped a training-only invariant.

zero_training.description: True iff the dual-lock no-training escape hatch was confirmed (alignment_facts.zero_training declared AND a matching frozen-variable entry) — never true from a single unchecked flag.

skipped_invariants.description: Which training-only invariants (preprocessing/precision/label_space match, 'pretrained' declaration) were skipped because zero_training is true. Empty whenever zero_training is false.
